t: Norton Expert Multi-Material Universal Diamond Blade offers a powerful cut through concrete, roof tiles, bricks, block paving and kerb stone. Continuous rimmed blade is suitable for dry cutting of various building materials. Turbo segments push material away from the grinding area for a fast cut. Suitable for angle grinders. Part of the Norton Expert Diamond Blade range.
b: For Brick, Concrete, Reinforced Concrete & Roofing Tiles
